cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.28% · WTI +2.05% · Brent -2.86% · NatGas +11.53%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +1.89%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.89%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -2.20%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ENPH is the standout at -16.31%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +12.98%, PWR +7.11%, NXT +5.72%, EOSE +5.49%, UEC +3.61%. Laggards: ENPH -16.31%, SEDG -8.92%, BKR -6.99%, NOV -6.37%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.13% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
